q: Two $10\,\Omega$ resistors are connected in parallel. What is their total resistance?
a: $\tfrac{1}{R} = \tfrac{1}{10\,\Omega} + \tfrac{1}{10\,\Omega} = \tfrac{2}{10\,\Omega}$, so $R = 5.0\,\Omega$: half the resistance of one resistor.
